subject: Civic Education
lesson: Explains the measures that can be taken for cultural integration in a multicultural society: Institutional Fact-Finding Station: Competency Level 8.3.3
unique_learning_outcome: Explains the measures that can be taken for cultural integration in a multicultural society.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Introduces the specific real-world Sri Lankan dilemma or scenario for 'Explains the measures that can be taken for cultural integration in a multicultural society: Institutional Fact-Finding Station: Competency Level 8.3.3', presents concrete inquiry task cards/materials, and assigns active group roles. Students examine the prompt, divide responsibilities, and formulate inquiry questions.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students examine the provided scenario or accessible surroundings, record evidence, and compare findings. Standard class layout (40 students): Desks arranged into 8 teams (8 groups of 5), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_aids: Inquiry task cards/materials, scenario briefs, role badges, observation grids, chart paper, markers

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Circulates across 8 teams, facilitating role execution and formatively checking progress. Asks probing questions to scaffold learning without lecturing.

lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_aids: Worksheets and activity cards for Institutional Fact-Finding Station: Competency Level 8.3.3, chart paper, markers
